questions.questionText: Vaishali booked a bus ticket for Rs. 1,260. Because of her ill health, she had to cancel the ticket. She got a refund of Rs. 945 in this process. What is the percentage loss that Vaishali had to face?
questions.questionTextHi: वैशाली ने 1,260 रुपये की बस टिकट बुक की। अपनी खराब सेहत के कारण उसे टिकट रद्द करना पड़ा। इस प्रक्रिया में उसे 945 रुपये का रिफंड मिला। वैशाली को कितने प्रतिशत हानि उठानी पड़ी?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Original price of the ticket = Rs. 1,260.

Refund amount = Rs. 945.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage loss = (Loss / Original price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Loss = Original price - Refund amount

⇒ Loss = 1260 - 945

⇒ Loss = Rs. 315

Percentage loss = (315 / 1260) × 100

Percentage loss = (1 / 4) × 100

Percentage loss = 25%

**The percentage loss that Vaishali had to face is 25%.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

टिकट की मूल राशि = 1,260 रुपये

रिफंड राशि = 945 रुपये

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

प्रतिशत हानि = (हानि / मूल राशि ) × 100

**गणना:**

हानि = मूल राशि - रिफंड राशि

⇒ हानि = 1260 - 945

⇒ हानि = 315 रुपये

प्रतिशत हानि = (315 / 1260) × 100

प्रतिशत हानि = (1 / 4) × 100

प्रतिशत हानि = 25%

**वैशाली को 25% की हानि उठानी पड़ी।**

questions.questionText: The average age of 30 student of a class is 12 years 4 month. After admission of five new student in the class the average become 11 years 9 months. One of the five new student is 8 years 7 month old. Find the average age of the remaining four new students.
questions.questionTextHi: एक कक्षा के 30 छात्रों की औसत आयु 12 वर्ष 4 माह है। कक्षा में पाँच नए छात्रों के प्रवेश के बाद औसत 11 वर्ष 9 माह हो जाता है। पाँच नए छात्रों में से एक 8 वर्ष 7 माह का है। शेष चार नए छात्रों की औसत आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

The average age of 30 student of a class = 12 years 4 month

After admission of 5 new students the new average = 11years 9 month

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of Observations) ÷ (Total Numbers of Observations)

**Calculation:**

Sum of the average of the 30 student of the class = 30 × \(12\frac{4}{12}\) = \(30 × 12\frac{1}{3}\) = \(30 × \frac{37}{3}\) = 370 years

5 new student got admission then total student is = 30 + 5 = 35

⇒ Total age of 35 student = 35 × \(11\frac{9}{12}\) = \(35\times 11\frac{3}{4}\) = \(35\times \frac{47}{4} = \frac{1645}{4}\) years

⇒ Total age of 5 new student = \(\frac{1645}{4} - 370\) 

⇒  \( \frac{1645 - 1480}{4} = \frac{165}{4}\) = 41 years 3 month

Now, 

Age of one of the five new student = 8 years 7 month

⇒ Age of remaining 4 student = 41 years 3 month - 8 years 7 month

⇒ 40 years 15 month - 8 years 7 month = 32 year 8 month

⇒ Sum of the Age of remaining 4 students = 32 year 8 month

⇒ Average age of the remaining four new student = 32 year 8 month ÷ 4 = 8 year 2 month 

**∴ Average age of the remaining four new student is 8 years 2 month.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

एक कक्षा के 30 छात्रों की औसत आयु = 12 वर्ष 4 माह

5 नए छात्रों के प्रवेश के बाद नया औसत = 11 वर्ष 9 माह

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

औसत = (प्रेक्षणों का योगफल) ÷ (प्रेक्षणों की कुल संख्या)

**गणना:**

कक्षा के 30 छात्रों के औसत का योगफल = 30 × \(12\frac{4}{12}\) = \(30 × 12\frac{1}{3}\) = \(30 × \frac{37}{3}\) = 370 वर्ष

5 नए छात्रों को प्रवेश मिला तो कुल छात्र हैं = 30 + 5 = 35

⇒ 35 छात्रों की कुल आयु = 35 × \(11\frac{9}{12}\) = \(35\times 11\frac{3}{4}\) = \(35\times \frac{47}{4} = \frac{1645}{4}\) वर्ष

⇒ 5 नए छात्रों की कुल आयु = \(\frac{1645}{4} - 370\) 

⇒  \( \frac{1645 - 1480}{4} = \frac{165}{4}\) = 41 वर्ष 3 माह

अब,

पाँच नए छात्रों में से एक की आयु = 8 वर्ष 7 माह

⇒ शेष 4 छात्रों की आयु = 41 वर्ष 3 माह - 8 वर्ष 5 माह

⇒ 40 वर्ष 15 माह - 8 वर्ष 7 माह = 32 वर्ष 8 माह

⇒ शेष 4 छात्रों की आयु का योगफल = 32 वर्ष 8 माह

⇒ शेष चार नए छात्रों की औसत आयु = 32 वर्ष 8 माह ÷ 4 = 8 वर्ष 2 माह 

∴ **शेष चार नए छात्रों की औसत आयु 8 वर्ष 2 माह है।**

questions.questionText: In a right-angled triangle ABC such that ∠BAC = 90° and AD is perpendicular to BC. If the area of ΔABC is 63 cm2, area of ΔACD = 7 cm2, and AC = 5 cm, then the length of BC is equal to:
questions.questionTextHi: एक समकोण त्रिभुज ABC में इस प्रकार कि ∠BAC = 90° और AD, BC पर लंबवत है। यदि ΔABC का क्षेत्रफल 63 सेमी2 है, ΔACD का क्षेत्रफल 7 सेमी2 है, और AC = 5 सेमी है, तो BC की लंबाई कितनी होगी?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Area of ΔABC = 63 cm2

Area of ΔACD = 7 cm2

AC = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

If ΔABC ∼ ΔXYZ, then

ar(ΔABC) / ar(ΔXYZ) = (AB/XY)2 = (BC/YZ)2 = (AC/XZ)2

**Calculation:**

In ΔABC and ΔACD

∠BAC = ∠ADC = 90° 

∠C = ∠C   (Common in both triangles)

So, ΔABC ∼ ΔDAC  (by AA Similarity)

Now,

ar(ΔABC) / ar(ΔACD) = (BC/AC)2

⇒ 63/7 = (BC/5)2

⇒ 9/1 = (BC/5)2

⇒ √(9/1) = BC/5

⇒ 3 = BC/5

⇒ BC = 5 × 3 = 15 cm

**∴ The length of BC is 15 cm**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया:**

ΔABC का क्षेत्रफल = 63 सेमी2

ΔACD का क्षेत्रफल = 7 सेमी2

AC = 5 सेमी

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

यदि ΔABC ∼ ΔXYZ है, तो

क्षेत्रफल(ΔABC) / क्षेत्रफल(ΔXYZ) = (AB/XY)2 = (BC/YZ)2 = (AC/XZ)2

गणना:**

ΔABC और ΔACD में

∠BAC = ∠ADC = 90°

∠C = ∠C (दोनों त्रिभुजों में उभयनिष्ठ)

अतः, ΔABC ∼ Δ DAC (AA समरूपता से)

अब,

क्षेत्रफल(ΔABC) / क्षेत्रफल(ΔACD) = (BC/AC)2

⇒ 63/7 = (BC/5)2

⇒ 9/1 = (BC/5)2

⇒ √(9/1) = BC/5

⇒ 3 = BC/5

⇒ BC = 5 × 3 = 15 सेमी

**∴ BC की लंबाई 15 सेमी है**

If 'A' denotes 'addition', 'B' denotes 'multiplication', 'C' denotes 'subtraction', and 'D' denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following expression?

90 D (2 B 5) A 4 B (12 A 10) C 4 B (17 C 10)

यदि 'A' का अर्थ 'जोड़' है, 'B' का अर्थ 'गुणा' है, 'C' का अर्थ 'घटाव' है, और 'D' का अर्थ 'भाग' है, तो निम्नलिखित व्यंजक का मान क्या होगा?

90 D (2 B 5) A 4 B (12 A 10) C 4 B (17 C 10)
questions.explanation:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

'A' denotes 'addition', 'B' denotes 'multiplication', 'C' denotes 'subtraction', and 'D' denotes 'division',

**Alphabet** 
			 A 
			 B 
			 C 
			 D 

**Symbol** 
			 + 
			 ×  
			 - 
			 ÷  

Given equation : 90 D (2 B 5) A 4 B (12 A 10) C 4 B (17 C 10)

After replacing the symbols instead of alphabets in given equation is as follows : 90 ÷ (2 × 5) + 4 × (12 + 10) - 4 × (17 - 10)

= 90 ÷ **(2 × 5)** + 4 × **(12 + 10)** - 4 × **(17 - 10)**

= **90 ÷ 10** + 4 × 22 - 4 × 7

= 9 + **4 × 22** - **4 × 7**

= **9 + 88** - 28

= **97 - 28**

**= 69**

Hence, the correct answer is **"69".**

questions.questionText: Raja borrowed Rs. 15,000 on simple interest at the rate of 13% per annum and lent it on compound interest at the rate of 15% per annum, compounded annually. What is Raja's gain in two years?

questions.explanation:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 15,000 

Rate of simple interest = 13%

Time = 2 years

Rate for Compound interest = 15%

Formula Used:

Amount = Principal × (1 + Rate/100)Time

Calculation:

Simple interest = PRT/100 = (15000 × 13 × 2) / 100 = 3,900

Amount to be returned = Rs. 15000(1 + 15/100)2 = 15000 × \(\frac{529}{400}\)

⇒ Rs.19,837.50

Interest = Amount - Principal = 19,837.50 - 15,000 = 4,837.50

Gain = CI - SI = 4,837.50 - 3,900 = Rs.937.50

∴ The gain is Rs. 937.50.

questions.questionText: Two cubes have their volumes in the ratio 1 ∶ 27. The ratio of their surface areas will be:
questions.questionTextHi: दो घनों के आयतन का अनुपात 1 ∶ 27 है। उनके पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात होगा:
questions.explanation:
Concept use:**

Volume of Cube = a3,** **where a is the length of a side of the cube.

Surface Area of Cube = 6a², where a is the length of a side of the cube.

Calculations:**

Let's assume the volumes of the two cubes are V₁ and V₂, respectively.

V₁ : V₂ = 1 : 27

The volume of a cube is given by the formula V = s³, where s is the length of a side of the cube.

Let's denote the side lengths of the cubes as s₁ and s₂. Therefore, we have:

V₁ = s₁³

V₂ = s₂³

The surface area of the first cube (A₁) is:

A₁ = 6s₁²

The surface area of the second cube (A₂) is:

A₂ = 6s₂²

To find the ratio of their surface areas, we divide A₁ by A₂:

A₁/A₂ = (6s₁²) / (6s₂²) ⇒ A₁/A₂ = s₁² / s₂²

Now, let's relate the side lengths to the volumes using the given ratio:

V₁ : V₂ = 1 : 27 ⇒ s₁³ : s₂³ = 1 : 27, s₁ : s₂ = 1 : 3

Squaring both sides:

s₁² : s₂² = 1² : 3² , s₁² : s₂² = 1 : 9

Now we can substitute this ratio into the equation for the ratio of surface areas:

A₁/A₂ = s₁² / s₂² = 1 : 9

**Hence, the ratio of their surface areas is 1 : 9.**
questions.explanationHi:
प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:**

घन का आयतन = a3, जहाँ a घन की एक भुजा की लंबाई है।

घन का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 6a², जहाँ a घन की एक भुजा की लंबाई है।

गणना:**

माना दो घनों का आयतन क्रमशः V₁ और V₂ है।

V₁ : V₂ = 1 : 27

घन का आयतन सूत्र V = s³ द्वारा निकाला जाता है, जहाँ s घन की एक भुजा की लंबाई है।

आइए घन की भुजाओं की लंबाई को s₁ और s₂ के रूप में निरूपित करें। इसलिए, हमारे पास है:

V₁ = s₁³
V₂ = s₂³

पहले घन (A₁) का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल है:

A₁ = 6s₁²

दूसरे घन (A₂) का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल है:

A₂ = 6s₂²

उनके पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफलों के अनुपात को ज्ञात करने के लिए, हम A₁ को A₂ से विभाजित करते हैं:

A₁/A₂ = (6s₁²) / (6s₂²) ⇒ A₁/A₂ = s₁² / s₂²

अब, दिए गए अनुपात का उपयोग करके भुजाओं की लंबाई को आयतन से संबंधित करते हैं:

**Calculations:**

When the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time. If the ratio of speeds is a : b, the corresponding ratio of time taken is b : a.

**Calculations:**

Squaring both sides:

⇒ l2 + b2 + h2 = 121

We are given the Surface Area:

⇒ 2(lb + bh + hl) = 240

Substituting these values into the standard algebraic identity:

⇒ (l + b + h)2 = 121 + 240

⇒ (l + b + h)2 = 361

⇒ l + b + h = √361 = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19 cm.**

questions.questionText: Abhi can complete a work in 50 days. Varun is 25% more efficient than Abhi. They work together for 8 days. The remaining work is completed by Charu alone in 6\(\frac{2}{5}\)days then in how many days can Varun and Charu complete 75% of the original work?
questions.questionTextHi: अभी एक कार्य को 50 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। वरुण, अभी से 25% अधिक दक्ष है। वे 8 दिनों तक एक साथ कार्य करते हैं। शेष कार्य चारू द्वारा अकेले 6\(\frac{2}{5}\) दिनों में पूरा किया जाता है, तो वरुण और चारू मूल कार्य का 75% कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Abhi can complete a work in 50 days

Varun is 25% more efficient than Abhi

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time required

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of Abhi be 4 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Varun = 4 × (125/100) = 5 units/day

As Abhi can complete a work in 50 days

⇒ Total work = 50 × 4 = 200 units

Work done by Abhi and Varun in 8 days = (4 + 5) × 8 = 72 units

Remaining work = 200 - 72 = 128 units

Charu completes 128 units in 6\(\frac{2}{5}\) days

⇒ Efficiency of Charu = 128/(32/5) = 20 units/day

75% of total work = 200 × (75/100) = 150 units

Time required by Varun and Charu to complete 150 units

⇒ 150/(5 + 20) = 6 days

**∴ Varun and Charu can complete 75% of total work in 6 days.**

Total Time = d(2/18 + 1/18 + 1.5/18)

Total Time = d(4.5) / 18

Total Time = d / 4

Average Speed = (3d) / (d / 4)

Average Speed = 3d × 4 / d

Average Speed = 12 kmph

**Given:**

Cost of first variety of rice = Rs. 50 per kg.

Profit = 20%

Cost price of mixed rice = Selling price / (1 + Profit)

Given selling price = Rs. 70 per kg

Profit = 20% = 0.20

Cost price of mixed rice = 70 / (1 + 0.20)

Cost price of mixed rice = 70 / 1.20

Cost price of mixed rice = 58.33

We have, (50x + 60y) / (x + y) = 58.33

⇒ 50x + 60y = 58.33(x + y)

⇒ 50x + 60y = 58.33x + 58.33y

⇒ 60y - 58.33y = 58.33x - 50x

⇒ 1.67y = 8.33x

⇒ y / x = 8.33 / 1.67

⇒ y / x = 5

⇒ x : y = 1 : 5

**The ratio in which the two varieties are mixed is 1 : 5.**

questions.questionText: If a person drives his scooter at 45 km/hr, he reaches the destination 10 minutes late. If he drives at 60 km/hr, he is only 5 minutes late. In how many minutes should the person complete the journey to reach the destination exactly on time?
questions.questionTextHi: यदि कोई व्यक्ति अपने स्कूटर को 45 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलाता है, तो वह गंतव्य पर 10 मिनट देरी से पहुंचता है। यदि वह 60 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलाता है, तो वह केवल 5 मिनट देरी से पहुंचता है। गंतव्य पर ठीक समय पर पहुंचने के लिए व्यक्ति को कितने मिनट में यात्रा पूरी करनी चाहिए?
questions.explanation:
Let the distance to the destination be D km and the correct time to reach the destination be T hours.

Given:

If speed = 45 km/hr, time taken = T + 10/60 = T + 1/6

If speed = 60 km/hr, time taken = T + 5/60 = T + 1/12

Using the formula for time:

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Step 1: Write equations for distance:

At 45 km/hr: D = 45 × (T + 1/6)

At 60 km/hr: D = 60 × (T + 1/12)

Step 2: Equate the two expressions for D:

45 × (T + 1/6) = 60 × (T + 1/12)

Simplify:

45T + 45/6 = 60T + 60/12

45T + 7.5 = 60T + 5

15T = 2.5

T = 2.5 ÷ 15 = 1/6 hours

Step 3: Convert T to minutes:

T = 1/6 × 60 = 10 minutes

Final Answer:

The person should complete the journey in exactly 10 minutes.

questions.questionText: B1, B2 and B3 can do a work in 10, 5 and 7.5 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but B2 left 1.5 days before the completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.questionTextHi: B1, B2 और B3 एक कार्य को क्रमशः 10, 5 और 7.5 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। तीनों मिलकर कार्य शुरू करते हैं लेकिन B2 कार्य पूरा होने से 1.5 दिन पहले चला जाता है। कार्य कितने दिनों में पूरा हुआ है?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

B1 can do the work in 10 days.

B2 can do the work in 5 days.

B3 can do the work in 7.5 days.

B2 left 1.5 days before the completion of the work.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Work done by B1 + Work done by B2 + Work done by B3

**Calculation:**

Total units of work = LCM of 10, 5, 7.5 = 30 units

Efficiency of B1 = 30/10 = 3

Efficiency of B2 = 30/5 = 6

Efficiency of B3 = 30/7.5 = 4

Let the total number of days to complete the work be x.

Then, in (x - 1.5) days, B2 worked together with B1 and B3, and for the remaining 1.5 days, only B1 and B3 worked.

Work done by B1 + Work done by B2 + Work done by B3 = Total Work

⇒ (x - 1.5) × 6 + x(3 + 4) = 30

⇒ 13x = 39

⇒ x = 39/13

⇒ x = 3

**The work was completed in 3 days.**
questions.explanationHi:
**दिया गया है:**

B1 कार्य को 10 दिनों में कर सकता है।

B2 कार्य को 5 दिनों में कर सकता है।

B3 कार्य को 7.5 दिनों में कर सकता है।

B2 कार्य पूरा होने से 1.5 दिन पहले चला जाता है।

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

कुल कार्य = B1 द्वारा किया गया कार्य + B2 द्वारा किया गया कार्य + B3 द्वारा किया गया कार्य

**गणना:**

कुल कार्य की इकाइयाँ = 10, 5, 7.5 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य = 30 इकाइयाँ

B1 की दक्षता = 30/10 = 3

B2 की दक्षता = 30/5 = 6

B3 की दक्षता = 30/7.5 = 4

माना कि कार्य पूरा होने में कुल x दिन लगते हैं।

इसलिए, (x - 1.5) दिनों में, B2 ने B1 और B3 के साथ कार्य किया है, और शेष 1.5 दिनों के लिए, केवल B1 और B3 ने कार्य किया है।

B1 द्वारा किया गया कार्य + B2 द्वारा किया गया कार्य + B3 द्वारा किया गया कार्य = कुल कार्य

⇒ (x - 1.5) x 6 + x(3 + 4) = 30

⇒ 13x = 39

⇒ x = 39/13

⇒ x = 3

**कार्य 3 दिनों में पूरा हुआ है।**

⇒ a3 + a3 + b3 - b3 + 3a2b - 3a2b + 3ab2 + 3ab2 + 6a(a2 - b2)

⇒ 2a3 + 6ab2 + 6a(a2 - b2)

⇒ 2a3 + 6a3

questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
For three numbers a, b, and c to be in continued proportion after adding a number x, the direct formula is:

x = (b2 − a × c) ÷ (a + c − 2b)

Here, a = 15, b = 9, and c = 5.

x = (92 − 15 × 5) ÷ (15 + 5 − 2 × 9)

x = (81 − 75) ÷ (20 − 18) = 6 ÷ 2 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

The numbers are 15, 9, and 5.

**Formula Used:**

If three numbers A, B, and C are in continued proportion, then A : B :: B : C, which means the product of extremes equals the product of means (B2 = A × C).

15 + x
  
  :

9 + x
  
  ::

9 + x
  
  :

5 + x

Product of Means

Product of Extremes

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number to be added be x.

⇒ According to the continued proportion condition:

⇒ (15 + x) : (9 + x) :: (9 + x) : (5 + x)

⇒ (15 + x) ÷ (9 + x) = (9 + x) ÷ (5 + x)

⇒ (15 + x) × (5 + x) = (9 + x)2

⇒ 75 + 15x + 5x + x2 = 81 + 18x + x2

⇒ 75 + 20x = 81 + 18x

⇒ 20x − 18x = 81 − 75

⇒ 2x = 6

⇒ x = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

**Additional Information**

Continued Proportion

Three quantities a, b, and c are in continued proportion if a : b = b : c. Here, b is called the mean proportional between a and c, and c is the third proportional to a and b.

Mean Proportional

For any two numbers a and c, the mean proportional is given by the square root of their product: √(a × c).

Fourth Proportional

If a : b :: c : d, then d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c, calculated as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Componendo and Dividendo

A useful property of proportions states that if a ÷ b = c ÷ d, then (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = (c + d) ÷ (c − d).

questions.questionText: A person walked from a village to a hospital at a speed of 30 km/h and walked back at a speed of 2 km/h. If the whole journey took 4 h 36 min, find the distance of the hospital from the village.
questions.questionTextHi: एक व्यक्ति एक गाँव से अस्पताल तक कुछ दूरी 30 किमी/घंटा की गति से चला और वापसी यात्रा 2 किमी/घंटा की गति से तय करता है। यदि पूरी यात्रा में 4 घंटे 36 मिनट लगते हैं, तो गाँव से अस्पताल की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Total time = 4 h 36 min = 4.6 hours

Shortcut formula: Distance = [ (Product of Speeds) ÷ (Sum of Speeds) ] × Total Time

Distance = [ (30 × 2) ÷ (30 + 2) ] × 4.6

Distance = [ 60 ÷ 32 ] × 4.6 = 1.875 × 4.6 = 8.625 km

8.625 km = 8 5/8 km

**∴ The correct answer is 8 5/8 km.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Speed from Village to Hospital (s1) = 30 km/h

Speed from Hospital to Village (s2) = 2 km/h

Total time taken = 4 h 36 min

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Time = 4 h + (36 ÷ 60) h = 4 + 3/5 = 23/5 hours

⇒ Let the distance be d km.

⇒ (d ÷ 30) + (d ÷ 2) = 23/5

⇒ (d + 15d) ÷ 30 = 23/5

⇒ 16d ÷ 30 = 23/5

⇒ 16d = (23 × 30) ÷ 5

⇒ 16d = 23 × 6

⇒ 16d = 138

⇒ d = 138 ÷ 16 = 69 ÷ 8

⇒ d = 8 5/8 km

**∴ The correct answer is 8 5/8 km.**

**Additional Information**

Average Speed for Constant Distance

When an object covers the same distance at two different speeds s1 and s2, the average speed = (2 × s1 × s2) ÷ (s1 + s2).

Speed-Time Relationship

If distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (s1 ÷ s2 = t2 ÷ t1). Ratio of speeds 30:2 = 15:1 implies ratio of times is 1:15.

Unit Conversion

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18.

हानि % = (क्रय मूल्य - विक्रय मूल्य) / क्रय मूल्य

questions.questionText: Find the mean proportional between 3 and 27.
questions.questionTextHi: 3 और 27 के बीच का मध्यानुपाती ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The mean proportional between two numbers 'a' and 'b' is given directly by √(a × b).

Here, the given numbers are a = 3 and b = 27.

Mean proportional = √(3 × 27) = √81 = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

The two numbers are 3 and 27.

**Formula Used:**

If x is the mean proportional between a and b, then a : x :: x : b.

By the property of proportions, Product of Means = Product of Extremes ⇒ x2 = a × b.

  Product of Means = Product of Extremes
  
  3
  :
  
  x
  ::
  
  x
  :
  
  27
  
  Extremes
  
  Means
  x × x = 3 × 27 = 81
  Result: x = 9

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the required mean proportional be x.

⇒ 3 : x :: x : 27

⇒ 3 ÷ x = x ÷ 27

⇒ x2 = 3 × 27

⇒ x2 = 81

⇒ x = √81 = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

**Additional Information**

Third Proportional

If three quantities a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then 'c' is the third proportional to a and b. Formula: c = b2 ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If four quantities a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a : b :: c : d), then 'd' is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c. Formula: d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of any two numbers a and b is simply the ratio of their squares, expressed mathematically as a2 : b2.

Sub-duplicate Ratio

The sub-duplicate ratio of any two numbers a and b is the ratio of their square roots, expressed mathematically as √a : √b.

questions.questionText: An amount of ₹ 25,000 in 2 years at compound interest compounded annually, if the interest rate for the successive years be 4% and 5% per annum respectively, is:
questions.questionTextHi: 2 वर्षों में ₹ 25,000 की राशि वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर अर्जित होती है, यदि क्रमिक वर्षों के लिए ब्याज दर क्रमशः 4% और 5% प्रति वर्ष है, तो राशि कितनी होगी?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The effective compound interest rate for two successive years can be calculated using the successive percentage formula: X + Y + (X × Y) ÷ 100.

Effective Rate = 4 + 5 + (4 × 5) ÷ 100 = 9 + 0.2 = 9.2%.

Total Amount = (100% + 9.2%) of the Principal = 109.2% of ₹25,000.

Amount = (109.2 ÷ 100) × 25000 = 109.2 × 250 = ₹27,300.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹27,300.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹25,000

Rate of interest for the 1st year (R1) = 4% per annum

Rate of interest for the 2nd year (R2) = 5% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R1/100) × (1 + R2/100)

  Year 1

+ 5%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount = 25000 × (1 + 4/100) × (1 + 5/100)

⇒ Amount = 25000 × (104/100) × (105/100)

⇒ Amount = 25000 × (26/25) × (21/20)

⇒ Amount = 25000 × (546/500)

⇒ Amount = 50 × 546

⇒ Amount = 27300

**∴ The correct answer is ₹27,300.**

**Additional Information**

Effective CI Rate for 2 Years

If the rate of interest is the same R% per annum for 2 years, the effective compound interest rate is (2R + R2 ÷ 100)%.

Difference Between CI and SI

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years on a principal P at rate R% is given by the formula: Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)2.

Rule of 72

To estimate the number of years required to double the invested money at a given compound annual interest rate R%, divide 72 by the interest rate (i.e., Years ≈ 72 ÷ R).

⇒ X = 1.366 + 0.366 = 1.732 = √3 

**∴ The value of X is √3. **

questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Speed of the first train = 60 km/h.

Speed of the second train = 25 m/s.

**Formula Used:**

Speed of the second train with respect to a man sitting in the first train = Speed of the first train + Speed of the second train

**Calculation:**

First, we need to convert the speed of the second train into km/h.

1 m/s = 3.6 km/h

Speed of the second train = 25 × 3.6

Speed of the second train = 90 km/h

Now, calculate the relative speed with respect to a man sitting in the first train.

Relative Speed = Speed of the first train + Speed of the second train

Relative Speed = 60 + 90

Relative Speed = 150 km/h

**The speed of the second train with respect to a man sitting in the first train is 150 km/h.**

**Given:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations

⇒ Sum of weight of all members = 142 × 12 = 1704 kg

⇒ Weight of coach = 1704 - 1551 = 153 kg

 PT = √ {(PQ)2 - (QT)2 }

⇒ PT = 8√6

Length of direct common tangent, when 2 circles are touching externally,

where D is the distance between 2 centers

R and r are 2 radii of circles

Using the formula, we get

⇒ \(\sqrt{{{{20^2-(12 - 8)^2}}}}\)

⇒ √384 = 8√6

**Formula Used:**

Number of integers divisible by a, b, and c = (Largest number in the range / LCM(a, b, c)) - (Smallest number in the range / LCM(a, b, c))

**Calculation:**

LCM of 3, 4, and 5 = 60

Largest number in the range = 500

Smallest number in the range = 200

Number of integers divisible by 60 up to 500:

⇒ 500 / 60 = 8 (integer part only)

Number of integers divisible by 60 up to 199:

⇒ 199 / 60 = 3 (integer part only)

Number of integers between 200 and 500 divisible by 60:

⇒ 8 - 3 = 5

There are 5 numbers between 200 and 500 that are completely divisible by 3, 4, and 5.

सीमा में सबसे बड़ी संख्या = 500

सीमा में सबसे छोटी संख्या = 200

questions.questionText: A man bought a number of apples at 5 for ₹50 and an equal number at 6 for ₹50. If he sells them at 11 for ₹100, what would be his percentage profit or loss?

questions.explanation:
**Given:**

A man bought a number of apples at 5 for ₹50.

He bought an equal number of apples at 6 for ₹50.

He sells them at 11 for ₹100.

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = Total Cost / Total Number of Apples

Selling Price (SP) = Total Selling Price / Total Number of Apples

Profit or Loss Percentage = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the number of apples bought in each case be x.

Cost for first set of apples: 5 apples for ₹50

Cost for x apples = (50/5) × x = 10x

Cost for second set of apples: 6 apples for ₹50

Cost for x apples = (50/6) × x = 8.33x

Total Cost Price (CP) = 10x + 8.33x

CP = 18.33x

Total apples bought = x + x = 2x

Selling Price for 11 apples = ₹100

Selling Price for 1 apple = 100 / 11

Selling Price for 2x apples = 2x × (100 / 11)

SP = (200x / 11)

Profit or Loss Percentage = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

Profit or Loss Percentage = (((200x / 11) - 18.33x) / 18.33x) × 100

⇒ Profit or Loss Percentage = (((200 / 11) - 18.33) / 18.33) × 100

⇒ Profit or Loss Percentage = ((18.18 - 18.33) / 18.33) × 100

⇒ Profit or Loss Percentage = (-0.15 / 18.33) × 100

⇒ Profit or Loss Percentage = -0.818% = 100/121%

**The man incurs a loss of (100 / 121)%.**

**गणना:**

1 सेब का विक्रय मूल्य = 100 / 11

⇒ लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत = -0.818% = 100/121%

questions.questionText: A man invested Rs. 75,000 at the rate of \(7\frac{1}{2}\)% per annum simple interest for 6 years. Find the amount he will receive after 6 years.
questions.questionTextHi: एक व्यक्ति 6 वर्षों के लिए \(7\frac{1}{2}\) % प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज की दर से 75,000 रुपये का निवेश करता है। 6 वर्ष बाद उसे कितनी राशि प्राप्त होगी?
questions.explanation:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 75,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 71⁄2% = 7.5%

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ⁄ 100

Amount (A) = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (75,000 × 7.5 × 6) ⁄ 100

⇒ SI = (75,000 × 45) ⁄ 100

⇒ SI = 33,750

Amount (A) = Principal + Simple Interest

⇒ A = 75,000 + 33,750

⇒ A = 1,08,750

**The amount he will receive after 6 years is Rs. 1,08,750.**
